# @fundar/data-chart-telling

> Svelte 5 plot components (line, area, bar, density, histogram, box, violin, lollipop, dumbbell, cleveland, forest, bullet, slope, sparkline, heatmap, pyramid, scatter, geo) built on svelteplot, with titles, legends, tooltips, facets, timelines and value labels built in. Plots take pixel `width`/`height`; hover and tooltips are switched on with `tooltip` and a `hover` marker.

Start with the full guide: it lists the mental model, the props every plot shares, the switches and the rules that matter. Runnable examples are type-checked, so copy them as a starting point.

## Guide

- [Full guide](./llms-full.txt): API overview, switches, rules, state hooks (`useFigure`, `usePlot`), markers, theming
